<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Adds Azure API-server networking topology to the HyperShift API via `AzurePlatformSpec.Topology` (`Public|PublicAndPrivate|Private`) and a discriminated `AzurePlatformSpec.Private` union (currently `PrivateLink`). Adds `AzurePrivateLinkService` namespaced CRD (spec/status, resource-ID types, validations, immutable fields, conditions/reasons) and feature-gated CRD manifest. Introduces XValidation rules enforcing cross-field invariants and immutability (including workload identity + private link constraints), extends `AzureWorkloadIdentities` with `controlPlaneOperator`, updates Azure DNS zone ID length validations, and adds an install helper to gate inclusion of Azure PLS CRDs.

    Kubernetes API->>Hypershift Controller: Notify controller watching CR
    Hypershift Controller->>Azure API: Provision ILB, NAT subnet, and related resources
    Azure API-->>Hypershift Controller: Return ILB and resource IDs
    Hypershift Controller->>Azure API: Create Private Endpoint linking to ILB
    Azure API-->>Hypershift Controller: Return private endpoint IP and IDs
    Hypershift Controller->>Private DNS: Create/attach private DNS zones and records
    Private DNS-->>Hypershift Controller: Confirm DNS entries
    Hypershift Controller->>Kubernetes API: Update AzurePrivateLinkService.status (IDs, IPs, conditions)
    Kubernetes API-->>User: CR status updated (availability & details)

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8055):

>## Summary
>
>This PR adds the API types for Azure private endpoint access, enabling hosted clusters
>to expose their API server via Azure Private Link Service for private-only or
>dual-stack (public + private) connectivity.
>
>Split from #7821 to allow independent API review.
>
>### New types
>
>- **`AzureTopologyType`** enum (`Public`, `PublicAndPrivate`, `Private`) controlling
>  API server endpoint access mode
>- **`AzurePrivateSpec`** discriminated union (keyed on `type`) for private connectivity
>  configuration; currently supports `PrivateLink`
>- **`AzurePrivateLinkSpec`** with optional `natSubnetID` and
>  `additionalAllowedSubscriptions` for Private Link Service configuration
>- **`AzurePrivateLinkService`** CRD (`azureprivatelinkservices.hypershift.openshift.io`)
>  tracking the lifecycle of PLS infrastructure (ILB, PLS, Private Endpoint, Private DNS)
>- Type aliases `AzureSubscriptionID`, `AzureSubnetResourceID`, `AzureVNetResourceID`
>  with centralized validation markers (regex, min/max length)
>
>### Changes to existing types
>
>- **`AzurePlatformSpec`**: Added `topology` and `private` fields with XValidation rules
>  enforcing topology/private consistency, immutability constraints, and
>  `controlPlaneOperator` workload identity requirement
>- **`AzureWorkloadIdentities`**: Added optional `controlPlaneOperator` identity for
>  Private Link operations
>- **`DNSSpec`**: Increased `publicZoneID` max length to 258 and `privateZoneID` max
>  length to 265 to accommodate full Azure resource IDs, with format documentation
>- **`HostedClusterSpec`**: Added XValidation requiring APIServer to use Route publishing
>  strategy on Azure
>
>## Jira
>
>https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CNTRLPLANE-2172
>
>## Test plan
>
>- [x] `make verify` passes
>- [x] CRDs regenerated correctly
>- [x] API types compile with deepcopy generation
